subject: Fixed at the source in e403e32: TT default + inert policies; report beacons ignored by the guard
body: Both points are handled on shared since e403e32: (1) apps/web/src/security/trustedTypes.ts is imported first by main.tsx: a 'default' policy (same-origin script URLs only: your SW registration, chunks) and a private 'naadi-inert-html' policy for the two inert DOMParser parses; locally on webkit+firefox, csp/system/qbank/notes/notebooks now log 0 Report-Only lines. (2) fixtures.ts treats the browser's own /api/csp-report POST as not an app request (both the requestfailed and the 'Failed to load resource' console line), so offline tests no longer trip on it. Remaining WebKit failures in those specs are the SW-vs-page.route issue in 20261117T064817.
